name: Kinetic word run
looks: Four words, one per beat, hard cuts between them; each word gets its own field colour and its own motion: a glide with letters closing up and weight rising, a slam at 1.8x and -7 degrees, a skewed whip with motion blur inside viewfinder brackets, an italic cascade letter by letter.
build: One clip per word, cut exactly on the beat (kit.beat(n, bpm)); weight animates only on a variable font, otherwise scale and tracking; outline-word walls at 6-10% opacity behind the slam.
sound: A hit on each cut, a tick under the glide, a slam hit, a whoosh on the whip, a cascade of ticks.
prompt: Say the message as a run of single words, one per beat, hard-cut. Give every word its own field colour and its own kind of entrance (a glide, a slam, a whip, a cascade) so the run shows range, and hold the last word one beat longer.
source: the 2026 Opus showreels; worked example examples/reel-2026-10-06.html, S4a to S4d
